title: The alleviative effect of C-phycocyanin peptides against TNBS-induced inflammatory bowel disease in zebrafish via the MAPK/Nrf2 signaling pathways.
authors: Xu, Fenghua; Yang, Fei; Qiu, Yuezi; Wang, Chuansen; Zou, Qinglin; Wang, Lizhen; Li, Xiaobin; Jin, Meng; Liu, Kechun; Zhang, Shanshan; Zhang, Yun; Li, Bing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究藻蓝蛋白肽对斑马鱼结肠炎模型的缓解作用，涉及分子对接但对象为肽-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Ulcerative colitis (UC) is an incurable and highly complex chronic inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) affecting millions of people worldwide. C-phycocyanin (C-PC) has been reported to possess outstanding anti-inflammatory activities and can effectively inhibit various inflammation-related diseases. Whether C-PC-derived bioactive peptides can inhibit intestinal inflammation is worth research and consideration. METHODS: The inhibition activities of three anti-neuroinflammatory peptides were evaluated using 2-4-6-trinitrobenzen sulfonic acid (TNBS)-induced zebrafish colitis model. Subsequently, the abilities of peptides to promote gastrointestinal motility were also examined. The changes in the intestinal pathological symptoms and ultrastructure of intestinal, reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels, and antioxidant enzymes were then determined after co-treatment with peptides and TNBS. Transcriptome analysis was used to investigate the underlying ameliorating TNBS-induced colitis effects molecular mechanisms of better activity peptide. Furthermore, quantitative reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction and molecular docking techniques verified the mRNA sequencing results. RESULTS: Three peptides, MHLWAAK, MAQAAEYYR and MDYYFEER, which significantly inhibit macrophage migration, were synthesized. The results showed that these peptides could effectively alleviate the inflammatory responses in the TNBS-induced zebrafish model of colitis. In addition, co-treatment with TNBS and C-PC peptides could decrease ROS production and increase antioxidant enzyme activities in zebrafish larvae. Moreover, MHLWAAK had the most significantly therapeutic effects on colitis in zebrafish. The transcriptome analysis suggests that the effect of MHLWAAK on TNBS-induced colitis may be associated with the modulation of nuclear factor-erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) and mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) signaling pathway associated genes. In addition, molecular docking was conducted to study the prospective interaction between peptides and the key proteins that streamline the Nrf2 and MAPK signaling pathways. IL-6, JNK3, TNF-alpha, KEAP1-NRF2 complex and MAPK may be the core targets of MHLWAAK in treating colitis. CONCLUSION: The results suggested that the three C-PC-derived peptides could ameliorate TNBS-induced colitis in zebrafish, and these peptides might be a promising therapeutic candidate for UC treatment.
abstract_zh: 引言：溃疡性结肠炎（UC）是一种无法治愈且高度复杂的慢性炎症性肠道疾病（IBD），影响全球数百万人。据报道，C-藻蓝蛋白（C-PC）具有显著的抗炎活性，并能有效抑制多种炎症相关疾病。C-PC来源的生物活性肽是否能抑制肠道炎症，值得研究和探讨。方法：利用2-4-6-三硝基苯磺酸（TNBS）诱导的斑马鱼结肠炎模型，评估三种抗神经炎症肽的抑制活性。随后，检测了这些肽促进胃肠动力的能力。在与肽和TNBS共处理后，测定了肠道病理症状、肠道超微结构、活性氧（ROS）水平和抗氧化酶的变化。采用转录组分析来研究活性较优肽改善TNBS诱导结肠炎的潜在分子机制。此外，定量逆转录聚合酶链反应和分子对接技术验证了mRNA测序结果。结果：合成了三种显著抑制巨噬细胞迁移的肽，即MHLWAAK、MAQAAEYYR和MDYYFEER。结果表明，这些肽能有效缓解TNBS诱导的斑马鱼结肠炎模型中的炎症反应。此外，TNBS与C-PC肽共处理可降低斑马鱼幼鱼中ROS的产生，并增加抗氧化酶活性。其中，MHLWAAK对斑马鱼结肠炎的治疗效果最为显著。转录组分析提示，MHLWAAK对TNBS诱导结肠炎的作用可能与调节核因子-红细胞2相关因子2（Nrf2）和丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPK）信号通路相关基因有关。此外，进行了分子对接以研究肽与Nrf2和MAPK信号通路关键蛋白之间的潜在相互作用。IL-6、JNK3、TNF-α、KEAP1-NRF2复合物和MAPK可能是MHLWAAK治疗结肠炎的核心靶点。结论：结果表明，三种C-PC来源的肽能改善斑马鱼中TNBS诱导的结肠炎，这些肽可能成为UC治疗的有前景的候选药物。
